text:
Jordan (Acme): Hi team — our org (acme-ops, org_9876) depleted monthly credits this morning around local midnight PST. We expected a refill at 00:00 PST but calls are still getting 429s. Anyone else seeing this or know if resets are happening in UTC?

Alex (Support): hey @Jordan — sorry about the outage. Quick checks: are error responses showing \"quota_exhausted\" (monthly) vs standard rate limit? Can you paste the response body or any X-Quota/X-RateLimit headers? Also, what's the account timezone set to in the console?

Jordan (Acme): Response body: `{ "error": "quota_exhausted", "message": "monthly credits exhausted" }` Headers: `X-Quota-Remaining: 0`, `X-Quota-Reset: 2026-03-01T08:00:00Z`. We're configured as PST (UTC-8). That header looks like 08:00Z which is midnight PST — so puzzling that nothing refilled.

Alex (Support): thx. I'm pulling billing logs now. /cc @Priya (CSE) for plan and any manual adjustments.

billing-bot: [automated] Org org_9876 monthly_quota_reset scheduled at 2026-03-01T08:00:00Z for plan 'starter-monthly'.

Priya (CSE): Jordan — I can see a manual reserved_commit/promo applied on 2026-02-15; billing timezone is UTC. Looking at the quota ledger; will paste shortly.

Liam (EngOnCall): jumping in — can you run this and paste output: `curl -s -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/org_9876/quota | jq .`

Jordan (Acme): pasted output: ```{\n  "monthly_used": 1000000,\n  "monthly_allocated": 1000000,\n  "next_reset": "2026-03-01T08:00:00Z",\n  "prorated_until": "2026-03-15T00:00:00Z"\n}``` Wait — there's a `prorated_until` field.

Liam (EngOnCall): that explains it. Because of the mid-cycle promo/commit the system created a staggered reset window: the base monthly quota reset at 2026-03-01T08:00:00Z, but the promo/proration entry keeps the effective available balance clamped until `prorated_until` (2026-03-15). The reset job runs in UTC and merges multiple quota lines, and when a promo extends beyond cycle end it can prevent immediate refill. That's an edge case. I'm opening an investigation.

Alex (Support): short-term options for you: 
1) We can apply a one-time admin top-up immediately (recommended to avoid downtime).
2) We can alter the active billing entry to remove the promo/proration (billing change, requires confirmation).
3) Wait until `prorated_until` (2026-03-15) for automatic normalization.
Which do you prefer?

Jordan (Acme): we can't wait; please top-up now and we'll follow up on the billing change. Minimal outage is critical.

Priya (CSE): I've created ticket BILL-4572 to review the promo proration boundaries and billing UX. I'll request a manual credit and escalate for faster billing-side remediation. ETA for billing rule change ~ 3 business days.

Marta (SRE): small note from logs: ledger shows the reset job merges `base_quota + promo_quota` then applies `prorate_lock` when promo_end > cycle_end. That `prorate_lock` is the reason available tokens stayed at 0. PR to fix coalescing logic queued as #3221.

Liam (EngOnCall): hot path — I'll apply an admin credit now and post the action ID. Command I ran in admin console: `admin.credit.apply --org org_9876 --amount 150000 --reason \"emergency-topup\"`

billing-bot: [action] Applied admin credit +150000 tokens to org_9876 by Liam (EngOnCall) at 2026-03-01T09:12:03Z (action_id: act_20260301_001).

Jordan (Acme): confirmed — traffic restored and 429s cleared. Thank you!

Alex (Support): closing the immediate loop — manual credit applied, BILL-4572 opened for billing rule change, engineering PR #3221 targets safer reset logic that won't leave customers in a stale state when promos cross cycle boundaries. We'll email your finance contact with the ticket updates and planned timeline. :thumbsup:

Jordan (Acme): please CC finance@acme.com on the billing ticket.

Priya (CSE): added finance@acme.com to BILL-4572.

Alex (Support): marking thread resolved from support side. We'll follow up when the PR lands and when billing rule changes are scheduled. If you see anything else, reopen.

Jordan (Acme): all good for now — appreciate the quick turnaround.
